summary:
Implementation plan for KÜLV audit, improvements, and tweaks covering:
1. Plant library advanced search, multi-attribute filtering (sunlight, moisture, direct sow vs indoor, sowing calendar months), and Estonian heirloom variety details.
2. Canvas UX upgrades featuring smooth incremental zoom, an interactive picture-in-picture minimap with draggable viewport rectangle, and an accessible keyboard shortcut HUD overlay (? key).
3. Web Vitals & performance optimization with React.lazy code splitting across screens and heavy dialogs, lazy-loading Three.js/3D and Recharts bundles, and intelligent prefetch on hover.
